long_description:
A playful Mommy + Me yoga experience filled with movement, music, connection, and plenty of giggles. Designed for little yogis ages 2–6.

About this Event

Little Yogis: Mommy + Me Yoga is a playful, beginner-friendly yoga experience created for moms and their little ones ages 2–6.
Together we’ll explore movement, music, kid-friendly yoga poses, partner activities, breathing exercises, and moments of connection — all while creating sweet memories together.
And mamas, there’s no pressure for your little one to get every pose “right,” stay perfectly still, or make it through the entire class without a wiggle break.
Wiggles are welcome. Giggles are expected. 🤎
No previous yoga experience is needed for mom or child.

Please bring:
• One yoga mat for you and your little yogi to share
• Water
• Comfortable clothing you can move in
• Your little one 

Don’t have a yoga mat? A limited number of mats will be available for purchase for $10. Please arrive early if you need to purchase a mat.
